title: Hierarchical ais-hierarchical-menu--link__active class
body:
For design like magento it could be useful to have ais-hierarchical-menu--link__active

Right now I am only able to do this

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1689007/10792049/62d961fe-7d8b-11e5-9768-f5db5f77da02.png)

With ais-hierarchical-menu--link__active we would be able to put the blue border only for one link in the level 1
